title: EUREKA: Human-Level Reward Design via Coding Large Language Models
abstract: EUREKA is a human-level reward design algorithm powered by large language models, achieving state-of-the-art performance on a diverse suite of 29 open-source RL environments, outperforming human experts on 83% of tasks with an average normalized improvement of 52%.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're trying to teach a robot to spin a pen. You could manually design a reward function, but that's time-consuming and requires expertise. EUREKA uses large language models to generate reward functions automatically, leveraging their ability to understand natural language and generate code.

This approach has the potential to revolutionize the field of robotics, enabling robots to learn complex tasks without human intervention.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
EUREKA consists of three algorithmic components: environment as context, evolutionary search, and reward reflection. The environment code is used as context to generate executable reward functions, which are then improved through evolutionary search and reward reflection.

This process allows EUREKA to generate high-quality reward functions that outperform human-designed rewards.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
EUREKA was evaluated on a diverse suite of 29 open-source RL environments, achieving state-of-the-art performance on 83% of tasks with an average normalized improvement of 52%.

The results demonstrate the effectiveness of EUREKA in generating high-quality reward functions that outperform human-designed rewards.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
EUREKA has the potential to revolutionize the field of robotics, enabling robots to learn complex tasks without human intervention. The ability to generate high-quality reward functions automatically can save time and effort, and enable robots to learn tasks that were previously impossible.

EUREKA can also be used to improve existing reward functions, making it a valuable tool for robotics researchers and engineers.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
EUREKA's key innovations include its use of large language models to generate reward functions, its evolutionary search algorithm, and its reward reflection mechanism. These innovations enable EUREKA to generate high-quality reward functions that outperform human-designed rewards.

EUREKA's ability to generate reward functions automatically can save time and effort, and enable robots to learn tasks that were previously impossible.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
EUREKA is an open-source project, and its code is available on GitHub. Researchers and engineers can try EUREKA on their own robotics projects, and see the benefits of automatic reward function generation.

EUREKA can be used to improve existing reward functions, and to generate new reward functions for tasks that were previously impossible.
